foundation: Barrot V3 execution, verification and safety
research_pr_status: open_draft_unmerged; base is one main commit behind current main
key_findings: Coinbase's Q3 2026 filing shows a multi-product strategy: everything exchange, stablecoins/payments and onchain adoption. It renewed the Circle arrangement on the same terms while listing RLUSD on Coinbase across XRPL, Base and Ethereum.
Coinbase's Q3 stablecoin revenue was $306.905M, down about 5.4% year over year, despite average USDC balances reaching an all-time high; lower reserve rates offset balance growth.
Coinbase's Q3 net income includes $715.022M of gains on crypto assets held for investment, mainly Bitcoin and Ethereum; do not treat the headline net income as pure operating strength.

Circle's Q2 filing reports $12.442B USDC on Coinbase at quarter end, a 19.5% daily weighted-average share, and $324.6M Q2/$655.3M H1 distribution costs to Coinbase. Circle's reserve income was 95.2% of Q2 revenue and is sensitive to rates near SOFR.
Circle has diversified distribution and strategic ties: $100M Binance equity investment and a five-year USDC agreement, in addition to Coinbase and SBI relationships.

Circle Arc launched with USDC as gas; SBI Group is a founding validator, Coinbase an exchange participant, and Morpho a credit-market integration. This is a parallel stablecoin rail, not evidence of an exclusive anti-XRPL strategy.
Coinbase's cbXRP reserve page displays 150,942,337.33 XRP against 150,940,089.8 cbXRP, a displayed surplus of 2,247.53 XRP; refresh timezone is unstated.

Morpho Watch's candidate cbXRP/USDC market shows $59.2M borrowed and 90.4% utilization, but it is permissionless and not a verified Coinbase retail loan book. Coinbase's help docs confirm market-specific LLTV can be 62.5%, which weakens the earlier 86% versus 62.5% contradiction.

SBI Remit's official 2023 announcement confirms XRP bridge use for remittances to the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia; SBI VC Trade sends XRP in real time and Tranglo pays local currency. Volume and net inventory are undisclosed.
SBI Ripple Asia's 2026 tokenized-deposit POC uses XRPL, but XRP token use is not established.
Tokyo SBIC is the Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd., separate from SBI Holdings. Its ChatGPT training was for investee companies only.
